scope: Local initialization from this source checkout through its existing virtual environment. No external services or business repositories executed.
assertions: Both workspaces have empty catalogs, resources, plugins, and knowledge provenance.
Both workspaces pass deterministic workspace validation.
Each action store resolves under its own workspace root.
Generated core directories contain no Python runtime source.
The copied AGENTS.md bytes equal the source checkout guide.
The generated guide references a source evidence file absent from the generated workspace.
limitations: These assertions check local initialization and ownership paths only.
They do not test operating-system access control, cross-system tools, or credential isolation.
The source virtual environment was used; no new wheel build or Windows execution occurred.
Temporary generated workspaces were removed after the checks.
